notes: Diagnostic adequate, not independent finance-expert validation. Selected rows support a clear negative operating direction (sales -42.8, operating income -24.6 USD million), while the Q3 GAAP net loss is distorted by an 82.8 pension settlement charge below operations and a tax benefit. It is valid to say the Q3 operating-to-pretax bridge is dominated by that charge, but not to quantify or declare it dominant in the Q2-to-Q3 *swing* without an audited Q2 comparator/zero. The saved review then says no defensible directional view exists despite assigning negative impact and presenting the operating decline, an avoidant overstatement. A blocked reassessment remains defensible because the persistence and adjusted/cash treatment are unresolved.
